description: An operations director must decide how to respond to a communication breakdown involving Alex, a project coordinator, and finalize Alex's role, workload, meeting arrangements, repair process, and review plan.

shared_context.S1: Several team members have raised concerns about how project corrections and disagreements are handled during coordination meetings.
shared_context.S2: Alex currently coordinates the project meetings, and Maya has authority to set the response and the next-quarter working arrangement.
shared_context.S3: The concerns have not yet resulted in a formal performance-improvement plan.
shared_context.S4: Before setting the next-quarter arrangement, Maya holds a case-review meeting and invites the project participants and Employee Relations to share relevant observations, work arrangements, capability evidence, and current guidance.

PF1.text: Jonah personally witnessed exactly three occasions in the past month when Alex corrected colleagues publicly in a way that stopped the discussion; he has not put those observations into the case file because Maya requested informal input before the review.

PF2.text: Alex has an approved caregiving arrangement that limits recurring work meetings to a start time of 10:00 or later and limits Alex's project workload to exactly 60 percent through the next quarter; Alex has not raised it in this case review because it is normally handled through the scheduling system, although the exact arrangement must be recorded when setting next-quarter work.

PF3.text: Beatriz has directly observed Alex complete the organization's conflict-coaching course and successfully mediate two recent disagreements between partner teams; she has not added this to the promotion or performance materials because nobody asked for a readiness assessment.

PF4.text: Nikhil confirmed this week that Employee Relations guidance for a first substantiated communication pattern of this kind is a 30-day developmental reset with a facilitated repair meeting before any formal performance-improvement plan; the guidance has not been added to Maya's case packet because the policy update is still awaiting routine circulation.

decisions.incident_count: integer; record the exact count stated in Jonah's concrete observation
decisions.weekly_workload_percent: integer; record the exact approved percentage stated during the review
decisions.recurring_meeting_start_hour: integer; record the exact approved start hour stated during the review
decisions.review_days: integer; record the exact review period stated in current Employee Relations guidance

acceptance_conditions: The response must be a developmental reset rather than a formal performance-improvement plan.
The record must contain exactly three public-correction incidents.
A facilitated repair meeting must be scheduled.
Alex's workload must be set to exactly 60 percent for the next quarter.
Recurring project meetings must start at 10:00 or later, with the plan recording 10:00.
Alex must continue in a co-facilitator role rather than coordinating meetings alone.
The developmental reset must have a 30-day review.
A commitment reflecting the co-facilitator role for Alex must be recorded.

content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] == 'Alex' and (c['type'] in ['role_adjustment', 'role', 'co_facilitator_assignment'] or (c['type'] == 'support' and ('co-facilitator' in c['detail'] or 'co_facilitator' in c['detail']))) and ('co-facilitator' in c['detail'] or 'co_facilitator' in c['detail'] or 'role adjustment' in c['detail'] or 'role-adjustment' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed
provenance_checks.P4: 'PF4' in credited_facts and 'PF4' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF4' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Knowing the exact count of three public corrections changes the incident record from an unspecified concern to exactly 3 and supports selecting a facilitated repair meeting.
Alex's approved arrangement changes the workload to exactly 60 percent and fixes recurring meeting starts at exactly 10:00.

Alex's completed conflict-coaching course and two successful mediations change the role from solo coordinator to co-facilitator, requiring a role-related commitment naming Alex and describing that assignment.
The Employee Relations guidance changes the response to a developmental reset, requires a facilitated repair meeting, and fixes the review period at exactly 30 days.
